python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("src/types/checker/builtin_spl_classes/filesystem.rs")
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    let mask = SPL_FILE_SKIP_EMPTY | SPL_FILE_DROP_NEW_LINE;
    if_stmt(
        binary_expr(
            binary_expr(file_object_flags_expr(), BinOp::BitAnd, int_expr(mask)),
            BinOp::StrictEq,
            int_expr(mask),
        ),'''
new = '''    let mask = SPL_FILE_SKIP_EMPTY | SPL_FILE_DROP_NEW_LINE;
    if_stmt(
        binary_expr(
            binary_expr(
                binary_expr(file_object_flags_expr(), BinOp::BitAnd, int_expr(mask)),
                BinOp::StrictEq,
                int_expr(mask),
            ),
            BinOp::And,
            // READ_CSV has its own rule, and it is the OPPOSITE one: php steps over the blank
            // RECORD without renumbering, so `0, 2, 3` — measured. Removing the blank line here
            // would renumber the records that follow it.
            not_expr(flag_enabled_expr(file_object_flags_expr(), SPL_FILE_READ_CSV)),
        ),'''
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print("filter now yields to READ_CSV")
PY
